integrity.evidence: Complete self-contained proof and executable exact checker are embedded; no independent audit has been performed.

scientific_limitations: Finite unital semigroups only; in-arborescences point toward a specified unit root.
Variables are constant over each ordered pair of Green J-classes; individual edge label polynomials and outward-rooted trees are outside scope.
Overlap searches and examined literature cannot establish priority against unpublished or unindexed research.
Finite enumeration supports the proof but does not replace the all-monoid derivation.
title: Class-level arborescence factorization for finite monoids
